question: Who among the following was conferred the Dhyan Chand Award for life time achievement in sports for the year 2021 in the chess discipline?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhijeet Kunte.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abhijeet Kunte** is an Indian** chess player **who has represented the country in several international events.
 
• He has won several national and international tournaments, including the **Commonwealth Chess Championship in 2003.**
 
• Kunte has also been awarded the **Arjuna Award in 2002**, which is India's **second-highest **sporting honour.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dhyan Chand Award **is India's highest award for lifetime achievement in sports and games, given by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.**
 
• The award is named after the legendary **hockey player Dhyan Chand**, who won three Olympic gold medals for India in **1928, 1932, and 1936.**
 
• **Pritam Siwach** is a** boxer** who won a **gold medal **in the 2019 National Championships.
 
• **Sandhya Gurung** is a** football player** who has represented India in the South Asian Games.
 
• **Radhakrishnan Nair** is a **coach** who has trained several Indian badminton players.
